title: Oozy Melted Japanese Palm Sugar Noodles
description: A post-workout Japanese dish featuring fermented palm sugar and cheese-pull noodles, made with gluten-free friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection in a bain-marie.

ingredients.name: Japanese palm sugar
ingredients.notes: also known as nam tan pip

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a small saucepan, combine the Japanese palm sugar, fermented soy sauce, and 1 cup of water, and heat over low heat, stirring constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, grated daikon, and sesame oil, and toss to combine.
Pour the palm sugar mixture over the noodles and toss to coat.
Transfer the noodles to a bain-marie and cook for 10 minutes, or until the noodles are heated through and the sauce is bubbly.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional grated daikon if desired.
